definitions.gloss: to peel; to remove the skin, rind, or bark
definitions.explanation: To remove the outer layer of fruits, vegetables, or other items. A basic cooking and everyday expression.

examples.japanese: ⟦りんご→りんご：02269_ringo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{皮|かわ}をむく。
⟦じゃがいも→じゃがいも：05184_jagaimo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{皮|かわ}をむいて⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{茹|ゆ}でる→茹でる：02324_yuderu⟧。
examples.english: Peel the potatoes before boiling them.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包丁|ほうちょう}→包丁：04976_houchou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{皮|かわ}をむく⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦させている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I am having my child practice peeling with a kitchen knife.

notes:
USAGE:
An essential cooking vocabulary expression. The verb むく specifically means to peel by hand or with a knife. Different from ⟦{剥|は}がす→剥がす：00081_hagasu⟧, which means to peel off something stuck.

COMMON OBJECTS:
- ⟦りんご→りんご：02269_ringo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{皮|かわ}をむく (to peel an apple)
- みかん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{皮|かわ}をむく (to peel a mandarin orange)
- ⟦じゃがいも→じゃがいも：05184_jagaimo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{皮|かわ}をむく (to peel a potato)
- ⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{皮|かわ}をむく (to peel a daikon radish)

TOOLS:
- ピーラー⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{皮|かわ}をむく (to peel with a peeler)
- ⟦{包丁|ほうちょう}→包丁：04976_houchou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{皮|かわ}をむく (to peel with a knife)
